rules: status starts at 'pending' and may ONLY become 'passing' after the verify steps were actually executed and observed to pass.
Code compiling, typechecking, or looking correct is NOT sufficient to mark 'passing'.
If a verify step cannot be run, set status 'blocked' and fill 'blocked_by'. Never guess.
'deferred' means out of scope by explicit user decision. Do not implement deferred features.
Run `node scripts/features.mjs` to see the current tally. Never hand-edit the tally.
Update this file in the same change that implements the feature, not at session end.
